def process(fraud_military) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    df = fraud_military.copy()

    # First row contains headers; set them
    df.columns = df.iloc[0].astype(str).str.strip()
    df = df.iloc[1:].copy()

    # Keep only rows with a Military Status value
    df = df[df['Military Status'].notna()].copy()

    # Remove footnotes / non-status rows
    bad_prefixes = (
        'Note:',
        'Of the ',
        'Source:',
    )
    df = df[~df['Military Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith(bad_prefixes)].copy()

    # Parse Median Fraud Loss as numeric (dollars)
    df['Median Fraud Loss'] = (
        df['Median Fraud Loss']
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(r'[^0-9\.-]', '', regex=True)
        .replace('', pd.NA)
        .astype('Float64')
    )

    # Standardize status text
    df['Military Status'] = df['Military Status'].astype(str).str.strip()

    return df[['Military Status', 'Median Fraud Loss']]

def process(fraud_military_clean) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    df = fraud_military_clean.copy()
    # Keep only branch rows
    branches = ['U.S. Army','U.S. Air Force','U.S. Marine Corps','U.S. Navy','U.S. Space Force','U.S. Coast Guard']
    df = df[df['Military Status'].isin(branches)].copy()
    # Ensure numeric
    df['Median Fraud Loss'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Median Fraud Loss'], errors='coerce')
    max_val = df['Median Fraud Loss'].max()
    out = df[df['Median Fraud Loss'] == max_val].sort_values('Military Status')
    return out[['Military Status','Median Fraud Loss']]
